prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a low-speed head-on collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1087; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Inspection of the front end shows a cracked bumper cover, a bent upper radiator support, and a damaged hood leading edge, all consistent with a frontal impact at low speed. The pattern of crush and scuffing lines up with the reported collision, and nothing points to older damage on this vehicle. The proposed plan replaces the bumper cover, straightens the support, and refinishes the hood, and the labor hours requested are in line with the repair work described. The repair invoices reviewed show each operation billed once, with no repeated charges.
